# Lukewarm Pools & Spas

> Pool cleaning, regular pool care, pool interiors and resurfacing, pool repairs, pool equipment and landscape design from Sydney to Newcastle, NSW. Based on the Central Coast. SPASA member with 14 years of experience in pools. Slogan: "Just right every time."

## What we do
- Regular pool care: cleaning, water testing and balancing, equipment checks
- Pool interiors and resurfacing: epoxy, pebblecrete and glass bead
- Pool repairs: leaks, skimmer boxes, liners and repair work other trades won't take on
- Pool equipment: pumps, filters, salt chlorinators and heaters (Waterco, Saltmate, Zodiac), supplied, fitted and serviced
- Landscape design around the pool: paving, gardens and surrounds
- Also: pool covers and rollers, chemicals and supplies, free water testing, robotic and automatic cleaners, heat pumps, LED pool lighting, pool automation, green pool rescue, leak detection, spa servicing, pre-sale pool cleans

## Prices (GST included)
- The Flow, fortnightly pool service: $79 per visit plus chemicals
- The Balance, monthly pool service: $90 per visit plus chemicals
- The Refresh, one-off full service: $110 plus chemicals
- No lock-in contracts. Chemicals are charged at what the pool actually uses.
- Green or neglected pools may need a recovery clean first, priced before work starts.
- Interiors, repairs, equipment and landscaping are quoted per job with a fixed price up front. Quotes are free.
- Referral program: regular customers pay less per visit for every referred friend who joins a regular plan, down to $67 a fortnightly visit.

## Strata and body corporate pools
Weekly or fortnightly pool servicing for strata schemes and owners corporations from Sydney to Newcastle: clean, water testing and balancing, plant room checks, a short report to the strata manager after every visit, and gate, fence and sign issues flagged. Month to month, no lock-in contracts. Free site inspection, then a fixed monthly price in writing plus chemicals as used.
Details: https://infolukewarmpools-droid.github.io/lukewarm-pools-website/strata.html

## Where we work
Sydney to Newcastle, NSW: Sydney, Northern Beaches, Hills District, Hornsby, Central Coast (Gosford, Terrigal, Erina, Tuggerah, Wyong, The Entrance), Lake Macquarie and Newcastle.
